# Brightwater Customer Inquiry Case Note
## Interaction
Date: 04/16/2026 | Time: 10:22 AM | Channel: Telephone
Representative: Colleen Rowland | Customer: Dmitri Coleman
Account: BW-704183 | Service address: 18 Willow Court, Cedar Falls, IA 50613

## Account snapshot
| Item | Record |
| --- | --- |
| Current balance | $86.40 |
| Due date | 04/25/2026 |
| Service | Residential water and sewer |
| Last payment | $75.00 on 03/28/2026 |

## Call summary
Brightwater billing privacy procedure requires the account PIN and service address to be verified before account details are disclosed. The caller said the March bill seemed higher than usual and asked for the current balance and an explanation of the increase.

I read the balance and due date to the caller. I stated that the account balance was $68.40 and due on 04/25/2026. The caller confirmed the service address as 18 Willow Court and said the household had not changed its water use. I explained that the account snapshot showed a $12.00 sewer adjustment posted on 04/02/2026, in addition to the monthly water and sewer charges.

The caller asked whether the adjustment could be reviewed. I opened billing review BR-260416-118 and attached the March statement for research. I advised that the billing team will respond by 04/20/2026 using the telephone number already listed on the account. No payment or service changes were made during this call.

## Follow-up
Queue: Billing Review | Owner: Grace Sandoval | Target response: 04/20/2026
Customer was advised to keep the existing due date while the review is pending.
